headline: Principal Platform Engineer
summary: Strategic technical leader with over 12 years of experience in architecting scalable distributed systems and cloud infrastructure. Expert in designing high-availability platforms, CI/CD automation, and securing cloud environments for fintech and enterprise applications in the Nepal technology ecosystem.

experiences.title: Principal Platform Architect
description: Lead the platform engineering division, overseeing infrastructure for digital payment ecosystems serving millions of users.
Transitioned legacy monolithic deployments to a containerized microservices architecture using Kubernetes, reducing deployment time by 60%.
Mentored a team of 15+ DevOps and SRE engineers to adopt Site Reliability Engineering principles.

experiences.title: Cloud Infrastructure Advisor
description: Provide strategic advisory services to local tech startups on cloud migration strategies (AWS/Azure) and cost optimization.
Design secure multi-region disaster recovery protocols for regional financial institutions.
Advise on compliance and regulatory data sovereignty requirements in Nepal.

experiences.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: Developed automated provisioning scripts using Terraform and Ansible for diverse client projects.
Implemented robust monitoring and observability stacks using ELK and Prometheus/Grafana.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to streamline the software development lifecycle.

experiences.title: System Administrator
description: Managed core Linux server infrastructure and internal enterprise networking.
Optimized high-traffic web service performance through load balancing and caching strategies.
